title: What the overseers found
question: What have the State fiscal-crisis team, the State Auditor, outside auditors, the college accreditor, the City Controller and the grand jury already put in writing about the district and City College?
finding: 44 findings from 7 overseers were read: 20 on the school district, 22 on City College and 2 on the county office. The State fiscal-crisis team rated the district at high risk of insolvency three times running (scores 38.4% in 2022, 50.7% in 2024, 42.9% in 2026). For the year to June 2022 the district's auditor gave no opinion on its accounts, with $184 million of federal money under audit. City College's auditors doubted in 2020 and 2021 that it could keep operating; its accreditor monitored its finances for three years, warned it in January 2024 and cleared it in June 2025.
how: Each row is one finding, restated in plain words, with one quotation of at most 25 words that the script checks against the document's text, the document's date and its link. Rows from the Federal Audit Clearinghouse come from the findings data already compiled in this project's record file and carry no quotation.
limits: These are the documents that could be downloaded. The district's own audit reports, interim budget reports and the State education department's letters are posted on services that could not be read by this project, and the district's page of audit reports has no link for 2021-22; findings from them appear here only as other overseers quote them. A finding describes a weakness in controls or reporting at a date; several were later corrected, and the State Auditor's 2017 college-readiness report and the accreditor's 2025 letter are favourable. None is a finding of fraud.
